name: Busy Bee Cafe
address: 810 Martin Luther King Jr Dr SW
sourceName: Busy Bee Cafe official locations page
ownershipEvidence: Busy Bee's official legacy page identifies Tracy Gates as owner and says her father Milton Gates purchased the restaurant; Resy's Atlanta feature explicitly describes Busy Bee Cafe and Paschal's as Black-owned restaurants (https://blog.resy.com/2020/05/black-owned-restaurants-atlanta/).
notes: Official locations page supplies the numbered address, phone, HTTPS destination, and current hours. Everyday food business; research only.

name: Paschal's
ownershipEvidence: Resy's Atlanta feature explicitly identifies Paschal's as a Black-owned restaurant and documents its Black entrepreneurship history (https://blog.resy.com/2020/05/black-owned-restaurants-atlanta/). Paschal's official site identifies founders James and Robert Paschal and the current restaurant address; the Georgia Encyclopedia (Emory University) independently documents the brothers' founding and Black-owned hotel history (https://www.georgiaencyclopedia.org/articles/arts-culture/paschals-restaurant/).
notes: Official homepage supplies current numbered address, phone, HTTPS destination, restaurant category, and hours. Near the Atlanta University Center/Spelman area; research only.
